body.ko: 연구실에서 학부연구생으로 함께한 주성용 학생이 PwC에 입사했습니다. 축하합니다!
body.en: Seongyong Ju, an undergraduate researcher in our lab, has joined PwC. Congratulations!

title.ko: ARES, Journal of Systems Architecture 게재 확정
title.en: ARES accepted to Journal of Systems Architecture

body.ko: 박성환, 백형부, 이재우의 논문 「ARES: Adaptive robust object detection framework for enhancing real-time performance in autonomous vehicle systems」가 Journal of Systems Architecture (SCIE)에 게재되었습니다.
body.en: "ARES: Adaptive robust object detection framework for enhancing real-time performance in autonomous vehicle systems" by Sunghwan Park, Hyeongboo Baek, and Jaewoo Lee has been published in the Journal of Systems Architecture (SCIE).

body.ko: 「OD-SHIELD: Convolutional Autoencoder-Based Defense Against Adversarial Patch Attacks in Object Detection」이 IEEE Access에 게재되었습니다.
body.en: "OD-SHIELD: Convolutional Autoencoder-Based Defense Against Adversarial Patch Attacks in Object Detection" has been published in IEEE Access.

title.ko: AAAI Workshop on Privacy-Preserving AI 논문 발표
title.en: Paper presented at the AAAI Workshop on Privacy-Preserving AI

body.ko: 「A Benchmark of Unlearnable Examples for Medical Images」를 AAAI Workshop on Privacy-Preserving Artificial Intelligence에서 발표했습니다.
body.en: "A Benchmark of Unlearnable Examples for Medical Images" was presented at the AAAI Workshop on Privacy-Preserving Artificial Intelligence.

body.ko: 「ELFS: Entropy-based Loss Function Selection for Global Model Accuracy in Federated Learning」이 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data에 게재되었습니다.
body.en: "ELFS: Entropy-based Loss Function Selection for Global Model Accuracy in Federated Learning" was published at the 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data.
